name: Pipedrive
description: Pipedrive is a sales-focused CRM built around a visual pipeline, letting sales teams track leads and deals as they move through stages, with automation and AI features to reduce manual data entry.
best_for: Pipedrive positions itself for small to mid-sized sales teams who want a straightforward, adaptable alternative to more complex enterprise CRM systems.
features: Lead and deal management with centralized contact history
Two-way email sync across multiple accounts
Workflow automation and AI sales assistance

tiers.name: Lite
tiers.notes: Per seat/month, billed annually (US$168/seat/year). Lead, calendar and pipeline management.

tiers.name: Growth
tiers.notes: Per seat/month, billed annually (US$468/seat/year). Full email sync, automations and nurturing sequences.

tiers.name: Premium
tiers.notes: Per seat/month, billed annually (US$708/seat/year). Lead generation/routing, AI-powered multi-email tools, e-signatures.

tiers.name: Ultimate
tiers.notes: Per seat/month, billed annually (US$948/seat/year). Sandbox account, extended phone support, security alerts.

alternatives.name: HubSpot
alternatives.description: A CRM platform with a free tier covering contact, deal, and pipeline management alongside marketing and service tools.
alternatives.best_for: Startups and small businesses that want to start free and scale up

alternatives.name: Salesforce
alternatives.description: A cloud-based CRM platform that centralizes customer data across sales, service, marketing, and IT.
alternatives.best_for: Larger organizations wanting one AI-enabled platform across departments
